$schema_note: Etsy SKU registry. One entry per listing. Blob path is the versioned Azure path; bump version + path together when rotating after a leak. The 'secret' field is intentionally null in v1 of this design — the redemption endpoint reads it and skips token verification when null. When you later want per-SKU rotation without leaving an asset open, set secret to a long random string and pass ?t=<secret> in the Etsy PDF URL. Code paths handle both modes from day one.

packs.title: MBTI Character Pack: Marvel, Ghibli & Friends (100 Personality Cards)
packs.description: 100 printable 3:4 character portraits assigned by MBTI personality type. Covers 66 Marvel heroes, 23 Studio Ghibli characters, and 11 from Friends. Use for personality quizzes, classroom decor, or fan-art reference.

packs.title: Kids English-Chinese Bilingual Vocabulary Cards (108 Flashcards)
packs.description: 108 printable bilingual vocabulary flashcards for early-childhood English-Chinese learning. Covers 12 themed topics — animals, food, nature, family, transportation, weather, body, emotions, celebrations, school, space, and life cycles. Each card has 8 vocab items with pinyin pronunciation.

packs.title: Phonics Pack: 50 Blend, Digraph & Vowel Pattern Posters
packs.description: 50 printable phonics posters for early-childhood English learning. Covers consonant blends (bl, br, cl, cr, dr, fl, fr, gl, gr, pl, pr, sc, sk, sl, sm, sn, sp, st, sw, tr, tw), consonant digraphs (ch, ck, ng, ph, sh, th, wh), vowel digraphs (ai, ay, ea, ee, ei, ey, ie, oa, oe, oi, oo, ou, ow, ue, ui), r-controlled vowels (ar, er, ir, or, ur), and trigraphs (scr, str). Each poster shows 6-8 example words with cartoon illustrations on a bright kid-friendly background. Use for classroom decor, homeschool curriculum, ESL phonics drills, or reading-readiness practice.

packs.title: World Cup 2026 National Team Squad Posters (48 Countries)
packs.description: 48 printable celebrity-poster-style squad posters — one per nation in the FIFA World Cup 2026 finals. Use for sports-bar decor, fan-art walls, classroom geography units, World Cup viewing parties, or as printable wallpapers for the tournament window.

Includes a print-ready 50-page PDF reading book PLUS all 50 individual card images. Authored-verbatim text with native-checked tones. Use for homeschool Chinese, ESL/CSL classrooms, or bilingual bedtime reading.

packs.title: Chinese Herbal Medicine Botanical Posters (54 TCM Apothecary Prints)
packs.description: 54 printable botanical study posters of Chinese medicinal herbs — ginseng, goji berry, astragalus, angelica, honeysuckle, notoginseng, mulberry, and more. Each aged-parchment poster pairs a detailed botanical illustration with Traditional Chinese Medicine property tags (Four Qi, Five Flavors, meridians), traditional and modern dosage forms, and magnified detail views, labeled in English + Chinese. Use for herbalist and apothecary studio decor, kitchen and cottagecore wall art, TCM / naturopathy education, or botanical print collections.

packs.title: Bilingual Vocabulary Scene Posters (32 English-Chinese Scenes)
packs.description: 32 printable bilingual English-Chinese vocabulary scene posters. Generic original characters, no franchises. Use for ESL / CSL classrooms, homeschool language immersion, or bilingual vocabulary building.

packs.title: Cute Illustrated Travel Maps (34 City & Country Posters)
packs.description: 34 printable hand-drawn travel map posters — Tokyo, Osaka, Bangkok, Seoul, Egypt, Greece, Iceland, Dubai, Beijing, Xi'an, and more. Each kawaii-style illustrated map highlights top landmarks, must-eat foods, and travel tips. Use for travel wall art, gallery walls, trip-planning inspiration, classroom geography, or wanderlust decor.

packs.title: World Traditional Costume Study Posters (46 Cultural Prints)
packs.description: 46 printable traditional-costume study posters from around the world — Chinese dynasties (Tang, Song, Ming, Qing, Han), Japanese kimono, Korean hanbok, Indian sari, Andean poncho, Mexican charro, Māori kākahu, Ukrainian vyshyvanka, Zulu isicholo, and more. packs.title: World Cuisine Bilingual Food Vocabulary Cards (30 Culinary Posters)
packs.description: 30 printable bilingual food-vocabulary posters spanning 30 world cuisines — Thai, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Chinese (Sichuan, Cantonese, Beijing, Yunnan, Xinjiang), Indian, Italian, French, Spanish, Greek, Turkish, Lebanese, Moroccan, Mexican, Peruvian, Brazilian, Ethiopian, and more. Each poster showcases signature dishes with an appetizing photo, the native-script name, romanized pronunciation, and English translation. Use for language learning, restaurant and kitchen decor, foodie wall art, culinary-school study aids, or travel menu prep.

packs.title: Empresses in the Palace MBTI Character Posters (16 Guofeng Prints)
packs.description: 16 printable Chinese-court (guofeng) MBTI personality posters inspired by the palace-drama cast — one per MBTI type. Each ornate chibi-style poster pairs a character with their 16-type profile: personality traits, destiny/plot keywords, and an iconic quote, in a Qing-dynasty aesthetic. packs.title: Easily Confused Chinese Characters Study Posters (24 Homophone & Look-Alike Cards)
packs.description: 24 printable study posters for the trickiest look-alike and sound-alike Chinese characters — 的/地/得, 在/再, 做/作, 象/像, 带/戴, 买/卖, 己/已/巳, 大/太/犬, 密/蜜, 即/既, and more. Each poster shows the characters side by side with pinyin (native-checked tones), English meanings, and a memory tip that pinpoints the difference. Authored-verbatim text for correct tone marks. Use for HSK and CSL/Chinese classrooms, homeschool study, or self-study flashcard walls.

packs.title: Miniature City Map Art Prints (30 World Cities)
packs.description: Thirty world cities rendered as three-dimensional miniature landscapes built on their own antique street maps — Amsterdam, Istanbul, Kyoto, Prague, Seoul, Venice, Copenhagen, Edinburgh, Marrakech, Buenos Aires, Berlin, Vienna, Budapest, Stockholm, Helsinki, Dublin, Porto, Seville, Florence, Naples, Krakow, Bangkok, Singapore, Osaka, Taipei, Cape Town, Rio de Janeiro, Havana, Jaipur and Reykjavik. packs.title: Watercolor Region Map Prints (10 Illustrated Travel Maps)
packs.description: Ten soft watercolor maps — the British Isles, Scandinavia, the Mediterranean, Southeast Asia, the Caribbean, the Alps, Japan, the Iberian Peninsula, New Zealand and Central America. Each country is washed in its own colour and labelled, with iconic landmarks and animals illustrated in place. Warm enough for a nursery wall and accurate enough for a classroom. Print as a set for a travel gallery wall or singly by region. No watermark, A4/Letter.

packs.title: Vintage Butcher Chart Prints (30 Meat & Seafood Cut Guides)
packs.description: Thirty vintage-style butcher charts showing where every cut comes from — duck, turkey, goose, quail, pheasant, goat, venison, rabbit, veal, bison, wild boar, mutton, and a full seafood set covering salmon, tuna, cod, halibut, trout, mackerel, sardine, red snapper, eel, squid, octopus, lobster, crab, prawn, scallop, oyster, mussel and clam. For kitchens, butcher counters, restaurant walls, and anyone who cooks seriously. No watermark, prints at A4 or Letter.

packs.title: Commonly Confused English Words (30 Grammar Study Posters)
packs.description: Thirty posters covering the word pairs that trip up native speakers and learners alike — then/than, lay/lie, fewer/less, who/whom, farther/further, principal/principle, stationary/stationery, bring/take, imply/infer, historic/historical, everyday/every day, assure/ensure, elicit/illicit, discreet/discrete, council/counsel, cite/site, peak/peek, capital/capitol, desert/dessert, breath/breathe, allusion/illusion, emigrate/immigrate, adverse/averse, appraise/apprise, born/borne, canvas/canvass, credible/creditable, disinterested/uninterested, flout/flaunt and pore/pour. packs.title: Dessert Colour Lab Prints (10 Patisserie Kitchen Posters)
packs.description: Ten prints, each a nine-dessert grid built around a single colour story — blush pink, chocolate brown, citrus orange, matcha green, lavender, midnight black, caramel gold, berry wine, cream and ivory, turquoise mint. No watermark, A4/Letter.

packs.title: Chinese Classic Character Design Sheets (10 Panoramic Breakdown Posters)

packs.title: Vintage World Landmark Info Posters (10 Illustrated Guides)
packs.description: Illustrated landmark guides covering the Taj Mahal, the Eiffel Tower, the Great Wall of China, the Colosseum, Machu Picchu, Christ the Redeemer, Stonehenge, the Sagrada Familia, Angkor Wat and Neuschwanstein Castle. Each poster pairs a detailed hand-drawn illustration with the landmark's nickname, country flag, build date, dimensions and the facts a visitor actually wants, in the muted palette of a mid-century travel poster. packs.title: Traditional Drinks of the World Infographics (9 Illustrated Posters)
packs.description: Illustrated guides to the traditional drinks of Scotland, Ireland, the Caribbean, Germany, Brazil, Greece, Peru, Poland and Vietnam. Hand-drawn bottles, glasses and traditional vessels on a deep starred background, each labelled with its name and a one-line note on what it is and how it is served. For bars, kitchens, restaurants and home drinks corners.

packs.title: Artist Biography Infographic Posters (10 Art-History Prints)
packs.description: Illustrated biography infographics for Katsushika Hokusai, Gustav Klimt, Johannes Vermeer, Georgia O'Keeffe, Henri Matisse, Rembrandt van Rijn, Edvard Munch, Wassily Kandinsky, Paul Cezanne and Hilma af Klint.
